mapper.insert: insert into notice(title, writer, content) values(#{title},#{writer},#{content})
mapper.select: select notice_id, title, writer, content, regdate, hit from notice order by notice_id desc
select notice_id, title, writer, content, regdate, hit from notice where notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.update: update notice set title=#{title}, writer=#{writer}, content=#{content} where notice_id=#{noticeId}
update notice set hit=hit+1 where notice_id =#{noticeId}
